# Schwab URL Shortener overview
Request panels need Track D OpenTelemetry export. Replica panels need P2 Container Apps metric export. Analytics consumer lag must be emitted by Track D as `shortener.analytics.consumer_lag`; the outbox metric is `shortener.clicks.outbox.oldest_seconds`. Empty panels before those phases are expected.

content.title: Request rate by app
content.query: AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | summarize Requests=sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), AppRoleName | render timechart

content.title: P95 request latency
content.query: AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | summarize P95Ms=percentile(DurationMs, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), AppRoleName | render timechart

content.title: HTTP errors by app
content.query: AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where toint(ResultCode) >= 500 | summarize Errors=sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), AppRoleName | render timechart

content.title: Container App replicas
content.query: AzureMetrics | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where MetricName == 'Replicas' and _ResourceId has '/providers/Microsoft.App/containerApps/' | summarize Replicas=max(Maximum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), Resource | render timechart

content.title: Analytics consumer lag
content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where Name == 'shortener.analytics.consumer_lag' | summarize Lag=max(Max) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), AppRoleName | render timechart

content.title: Oldest unpublished outbox event
content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where Name == 'shortener.clicks.outbox.oldest_seconds' | summarize AgeSeconds=max(Max) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), AppRoleName | render timechart

content.title: PostgreSQL CPU and connections
content.query: AzureMetrics | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where _ResourceId has '/providers/Microsoft.DBforPostgreSQL/flexibleServers/' | where MetricName in ('cpu_percent', 'active_connections') | summarize Value=max(Maximum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), MetricName | render timechart
